answer: Proof of stake mechanisms mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to commit cryptographic capital, analogous to an anchor securing a vessel to a wharf. Like extracting yarrow for medicinal use, the validator selection process filters low-value agents. An attacker must acquire a ferrous majority of total staked assets to manipulate the network, rendering the cost of identity proliferation economically prohibitive compared to the potential gains from malicious consensus subversion.
